name: Peer For You Public Company Limited
summary: Peer For You Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides outsourced contact center services in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Outsourced Contact Center Services; Data Centre Service Development and Installation Business; Trading; and Others. It offers customer relationship management services, including consulting; placement and installation of contact center system by providing hardware and software equipment; and management of customer relationship center. The company also sells consumer products and services through digital TV and online media under the HAPPY Shopping brand name; and engages in fintech business through peer to peer lending platform. In addition, it is involved in the provision of turnkey total solutions; digital and credit services; and mutual brokerage securities. The company was formerly known as One to One Contacts Public Company Limited and changed its name to Peer For You Public Company Limited in February 2024. Peer For You Public Company Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
